comparison.objective: Select the correct takeaway box and seal it, versus tune and lock an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Container matching and lid/seal closure; no evidenced adjustment-tool use, fine parameter tuning, or repeated dynamic evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Correct box is matched and sealed; detailed seal thresholds are absent. Candidate requires quantitative physical-cycle behavior and setting retention.
comparison.reason: Generic closure and retention do not establish overlap with damper commissioning.
